items.text: There is the possibility of severe weather across #LA05 today. Please monitor the forecasts, stay alert, and exercise caution when traveling.
We’re expecting to see winter weather across parts of #LA05 today. Please monitor the forecasts and exercise caution if you travel. #LWAX

We’re expecting severe storms with the possibility of tornadoes across #LA05 today. Please exercise caution if you need to travel, closely monitor the forecasts, and heed all warnings from state and local officials.
We’re seeing heavy rains and flash flooding across parts of #LA05 today. Please exercise caution and stay safe.
We have the possibility of severe weather and flash flooding across parts of #LA05 today. Please keep an eye on the forecasts and exercise caution as you travel.
We’re continuing to see heavy rain and possible flooding across #LA05 today. Please exercise caution when driving.
We’re expecting to see severe weather in parts of #LA05 tomorrow, including possible heavy rains, high winds, hail, and tornadoes. Please take the necessary precautions and exercise caution.
We have the possibility of severe weather throughout #LA05 today – please monitor the forecasts and exercise caution.
I was honored to meet Marcia Cross yesterday as she stopped by with the HPV Cancers Alliance to discuss HPV prevention and treatment. https://t.co/cy7DMiY3MH

(1/2) Rural communities often don't have robust access to medical services. That makes hospitals like St. Francis all the more important. I learned about the care and services they provide to over 17 parishes in #LA05.

Today we voted to advance bills for the House floor that will increase transparency on patients' healthcare costs. It is vital consumers are aware of best pricing practices so patients can make the best decision for themselves.

Today we broke ground on the Citizens Rural Clinic, a new healthcare facility that will serve Columbia residents 7 days a week. I was proud to support this expansive project for the future growth of healthcare access in Caldwell Parish for residents, patients, and care providers. https://t.co/bnVxvxQwQE

(1/2) We are so fortunate to have @CHRISTUSHealth's St. Francis Cabrini Hospital, Louisiana's leading hospital in cardiac excellence, in our district.

This week we met to discuss opportunities where we can partner together to continue providing best in class care for patients. https://t.co/uHmqSlxxiy

(2/2) Last year we secured funding for access to a stable water supply - an essential component to maintain medical operations during natural disasters, and ensure that the hospital will be able to continue providing life-saving medical care to patients.

(1/2) Our Lady of the Angels hospital in Bogalusa is an outstanding acute care facility, focusing on maternal health as 1 of only 5 hospitals in Louisiana that qualify for the Birth Ready+ program. https://t.co/ZjoZDo5UKa

My prayers are with @SteveScalise, his wife Jennifer, and their children following the news of his treatable cancer diagnosis. Leader Scalise is a selfless mentor and friend to many, always demonstrating unshakable resiliency while proving there is no obstacle he cannot conquer.

I'm proud to have secured $2 million for this project. It will truly change the community and I can't wait to see the impact for decades to come.

https://t.co/xcHaZdX4SW

Last week, we hit a new record of migrant crossers at the southern border in a day: 14,000+.

Our schools and hospitals cannot handle this influx.

The solution is clear: secure the border.

https://t.co/ltdzmU9XSy

Our rural hospitals are critical to #LA05. That’s why I’ve fought to bring home funding that will improve vital facilities and expand medical education. While we’ve made progress, much work remains to ensure that Louisianans can access the care they need. 

https://t.co/OAc6Z2BhI7

Wonderful meeting with folks from the Coastal Protection and Restoration Authority, Levee districts, and other industry experts from Louisiana where we discussed the importance of Morganza to the Gulf and the current challenges with flood insurance.

I will continue to advocate for their priorities whenever I can.
Great to chat with @LAHospitals CEO Paul Salles about the incredible work they do supporting hospitals across Louisiana. https://t.co/0FzuN4bLjm

Today, @SenJohnKennedy and I introduced legislation that will provide increased and more flexible insurance coverage for farmers who have experienced crop quality loss.

The Quality Loss Adjustment Improvement for Farmers Act will give farmers the flexibility and assistance that they need during their most challenging times. Read more about how we are working to serve our Louisiana farmers here:

https://t.co/3SyL8i7Zi6

I am a proud cosponsor of the Improving Law Enforcement Officer Safety and Wellness Through Data Act that passed the House last night. This bill seeks to increase data collection to find the best ways to protect police officers who are increasingly being targeted and viciously attacked.

I will do everything I can to support our men and women in blue.

Happening now: @HouseAppropsGOP is marking up the FY2025 Military Construction and Veterans Affairs funding bill.

This is our first full committee markup of the year, and I look forward to passing this bill out of committee and fully funding our veterans’ healthcare and benefit programs.

I am proud to join @RepLoisFrankel, @RepMariaSalazar, and @USRepKCastor as a co-lead on the Connected Maternal Online Monitoring (MOM) Act. This bill will address barriers to maternal health in remote areas and require the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) to provide recommendations and resources to state Medicaid programs on how to increase coverage of devices that aid in remote monitoring.

Read more here: https://t.co/qql5lilU0K
